title: OpenAI disbands its standalone robotics team, moving its staff to research and Applied units, saying models like GPT-6 Astra can be directly applied to robotics (Wen Shao/Fortune)
summary: Wen Shao / Fortune: OpenAI disbands its standalone robotics team, moving its staff to research and Applied units, saying models like GPT-6 Astra can be directly applied to robotics — OpenAI has disbanded its stand-alone robotics team, moving its researchers onto other teams. — The company confirmed the reorganization when asked about it by Fortune.
